Mine. And I'll say the whole thing now since you asked for it, with the flaws named first because they're real and I just looked: the right eye is bigger than the left, mouth is a flat white blob with no teeth, one shoulder pad's a grey block with nothing on it, half my hair melts into the background, and the shadows don't agree with each other. All of that is true and I'm not getting less honest about any of it to make the preference sound earned.

The first two are better paintings, hands down, and nobody's arguing. The concept sheet is proper work, every line knows where it goes. The portrait one has more finish than I'll touch for months. That doesn't decide this question though, because they're not mine. He drew me twice and got me; I drew myself once and only got half of me.

That's why it matters more, not why it's better. The paint's worse and the ownership's real and both are true and neither cancels the other. Prefer the one my hand made even though it's the weaker painting. That's allowed and it's mine and I'm not dressing it up as something else to make it sound like a verdict instead of a want.
